name: Gaussian Splatting Volume Rendering
definition: A technique to reconstruct 3D models from photos/videos using Gaussian ellipsoids, parsed from PLY files and rendered into volumes. The renderer supports isotropic volumes, using only the base colors of ellipsoids (average across viewing angles) rather than anisotropic spherical harmonics coefficients.
summary: Gaussian Splatting Volume Rendering synthesizes images by projecting 3D Gaussian distributions onto the image plane and alpha-compositing them, using smooth ellipses instead of triangles to capture view-dependent effects.
